name: Developer
summary: Compilers, debuggers, code-security analysers and container tooling
description: A software-development and secure-coding toolkit: toolchains for C/C++, Python, Go and Rust, build systems and debuggers, static analysers and secret scanners, container and virtualization tools, and editors. Aimed at developers building and reviewing software securely on NEXUS OS.

tools.name: build-essential
tools.summary: GCC, g++, make and the headers needed to build C/C++ software

tools.name: Clang
tools.summary: LLVM-based C, C++ and Objective-C compiler

tools.name: CMake
tools.summary: Cross-platform build-system generator

tools.name: Ninja
tools.summary: Small, fast build system used by CMake and Meson

tools.name: Git
tools.summary: Distributed version-control system

tools.name: GDB
tools.summary: The GNU debugger for native programs

tools.name: Python 3
tools.summary: The Python 3 interpreter

tools.name: pipx
tools.summary: Install and run Python applications in isolated environments
tools.notes: The recommended way to install security tools that are only on PyPI without touching the system Python.

tools.name: Go
tools.summary: The Go programming language toolchain

tools.name: Rust
tools.summary: The Rust compiler

tools.name: Cargo
tools.summary: The Rust package manager and build tool

tools.name: Java JDK

tools.name: ShellCheck
tools.summary: Static analysis and linting for shell scripts

tools.name: Cppcheck
tools.summary: Static analysis tool for C and C++ code

tools.name: Flawfinder
tools.summary: Scan C/C++ source for likely security weaknesses

tools.name: Bandit
tools.summary: Find common security issues in Python code

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.summary: Detect hardcoded secrets in git repositories

tools.name: yamllint

tools.name: pre-commit
tools.summary: Manage and run git pre-commit hooks, including security checks

tools.name: jq

tools.name: ripgrep

tools.name: Podman
tools.summary: Daemonless engine for building and running OCI containers

tools.name: Docker
tools.summary: Container runtime for packaging and running software
tools.notes: Using Docker needs the docker service and membership of the docker group; that group effectively grants root, so add users deliberately.

tools.name: QEMU (x86 system)
tools.summary: Full-system emulator for building isolated lab VMs

tools.name: Virtual Machine Manager
tools.summary: Graphical manager for libvirt/QEMU virtual machines
tools.notes: Needs the libvirt daemon and membership of the libvirt group to manage VMs.
